items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Tommy Gwaltney contacted me about it. ... I had appeared down in Washington at Blues Alley several times.

ctx.x: Do you have any recollection about that State Department tour? Who was trying to organize it, or, at least your participation in it, where it would've gone and why it didn't occur?

I'm not sure. Tommy Gwaltney contacted me about it. I think Tommy was trying to get something together. He probably had been approached. I had appeared down in Washington at Blues Alley several times. And he probably wanted to submit this to the State Department. I have no -- in fact, I never knew what became of the idea. I only know that it didn't come through. There is a possibility that Fat Cat might've had something to do with it. You know, when Blues Alley first opened,
